description: Ensures an active, verified Synesis workspace session. Keep every task member inside task, including role, workGroupId, reviewTargets, intentId, claimEpoch, and claims; top-level task fields beside a task object are rejected. Before visible task mutation, include task.goal, task.acceptance, task.claims, and any knownDependencies as structured capability identifiers to announce intent and acquire the exact repository-relative ownership selectors; likelyScopes alone does not announce work or acquire claims. To extend a lane, follow the projected ensure_session continuation with its exact task.intentId and task.claimEpoch; existing claims and dependencies are retained.

description: Retrieves the highest-priority actionable coordination item. Call without arguments to read the durable coordination inbox. The optional completionRequested boolean is a call-local request to evaluate completion; after implementation, tests, and acceptance criteria are complete, call get_next_action once with completionRequested:true to request the exact publication projection. Missing or false continues implementation and does not inherit a prior request. The optional integrationCheck input is a read-only compatibility check of explicitly supplied candidate facts; it never advances a lane or WorkGroup and must not replace empty-argument polling or be treated as lifecycle completion. If the response is workflow IMPLEMENT without a concrete recommendedTool and arguments, continue ordinary coding in the assigned worktree and do not inspect protected .synesis/** metadata. Execute each concrete recommendedTool with its exact arguments before another lifecycle action. When the response is WAIT, end your turn: do not sleep or poll on a timer; Synesis wakes you when something arrives for your lane. For repeated IMPLEMENT or blocked projections, compare workflow.actionId, honor workflow.retryAfterMs (default 5000 ms), and stop after workflow.maxUnchangedPolls unchanged responses (default 3). Reset the count when actionId changes. At the limit, report the stalled actionId and stop polling until a fresh state-change signal or human input; an active WorkGroup alone does not justify repeated unchanged calls.

completionRequested.description: Request completion projection for this call only; false or absent continues implementation

integrationCheck.description: Read-only compatibility facts; never advances lifecycle. Do not use as a substitute for get_next_action with empty arguments or to close a lane.

name: get_next_action

description: Submits one strict contract or collaboration request. One public contract covers a claimed file: every agent can read it, and only the lane that claims the file publishes it. contract_publish publishes the complete contract over paths the caller claims, or its next revision, and may list in answers the change requests it covers. contract_bind accepts the exact revision of the contract over ownerPath for the dependency the caller names in capability; after the owner publishes a new revision, bind again. contract_change_request tells the lane claiming ownerPath what the caller needs, and asks for a contract where none exists yet. Only fields declared for the selected kind are allowed.

description: Responds to a pending coordination item or validates an implementation. For implementation_validation, get_next_action first projects result=inspect; execute it before reading/running tests with the projected capabilityRequestHandle and implementationRevision. Only after that exact validation workspace is active may you choose accepted or revision_required; revision_required needs a reason and contractField, the field of the contract you bound to that the implementation breaks. contract_change_response answers one change request against a contract of the caller's lane: accepted when the current revision covers it, or declined with a reason. For kind coordination_response, payload requires the owned request UUID and status; proposal is optional. The request target chooses the status; Synesis does not choose a CONTRACT judgment.
